solution.title: Oracle C2M Log Analysis & Health Monitoring (SLO Assurance)

products.name: Oracle C2M Log Analysis & Health Monitoring (SLO Assurance) — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish C2M log analysis and health monitoring — where the logs are, what to watch, early detection, and SLO tracking — so you maximize uptime and catch problems early, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn C2M logs into health and uptime you can prove

C2M and WebLogic produce a lot of logs — and the signal that keeps uptime high is buried in them. This solution establishes C2M log analysis and health monitoring: where the logs are (OUAF, WebLogic, batch), what to watch, how to detect issues early, and how to track system health against service-level objectives — so you maximize uptime and catch problems early, pilot-first.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M/WebLogic log landscape (OUAF, server, batch), the health signals, and the SLO model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (log access, health metrics, SLO definitions, alerting).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to locate and standardize logs, define the health checks and early-warning signals, track against SLOs, and validate, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (logs accessible, health tracked, SLOs measured) plus Best Practices for log hygiene and early detection.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

C2M logs turned into provable health and uptime — early-warning signals watched, SLOs tracked — so problems are caught before they cost service.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MLOG-Discovery.sh — read-only discovery of the C2M log landscape (OUAF, WebLogic, batch) and health signals
    • OC2MLOG-Remediation.sh — preview safe log rotation/cleanup to hold log filesystems within policy (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OC2MLOG-Report.sh — read-only daily health/SLO report from the C2M logs and early-warning signals
    • OC2MLOG-ScopeHelper.sh — build the in-scope log-source / host / signal target list for pilot and expansion
    • OC2MLOG-Validation.sh — read-only health checks and early-warning signal detection across the C2M logs

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
